title: Traps for Russian Speakers
description: Common collocations, prepositions, false friends and article phrases that Russian speakers often get wrong.

items.definition: to choose what to do after thinking about it
items.example: After weeks of discussion, the board finally [made a decision] about the merger.
items.exampleRu: После нескольких недель обсуждений совет директоров наконец принял решение о слиянии.
items.pattern: make a decision about sth / to do sth
items.trap: Not 'accept a decision' (calque of «принять решение»): 'accept' means agree to someone else's decision. 'Take a decision' exists in formal British English, but 'make' is the safe choice.

items.definition: to do something wrong or incorrect without intending to
items.example: I [made a mistake] in the report and had to send it again.
items.exampleRu: Я допустил ошибку в отчёте, и пришлось отправить его заново.
items.trap: Not 'do a mistake' (calque of «сделать ошибку»).

items.definition: to study a subject carefully to find new facts or information
items.example: She spent two years [doing research] on sleep and productivity.
items.exampleRu: Она два года занималась исследованиями сна и продуктивности.
items.trap: Not 'make a research': use do, and research is uncountable (no 'a', no 'researches').

items.definition: to improve or move closer to a goal
items.example: My Spanish is still basic, but I'm [making progress] every week.
items.exampleRu: Мой испанский пока слабый, но я каждую неделю делаю успехи.
items.trap: Not 'do progress' or 'make a progress': progress is uncountable.

items.definition: to use a camera or phone to make a picture of sb/sth
items.example: Could you [take a photo] of us in front of the fountain?
items.exampleRu: Можете сфотографировать нас перед фонтаном?
items.trap: Not 'make a photo' (calque of «сделать фото»).

items.definition: to wash your body while standing under running water
items.example: I usually [take a shower] right after my morning run.
items.exampleRu: Обычно я принимаю душ сразу после утренней пробежки.
items.trap: Not 'make a shower' or 'accept a shower' (from «принять душ»); use take or have (BrE).

items.definition: to help sb by doing something they have asked you to do
items.example: Could you [do me a favour] and pick up my parcel?
items.exampleRu: Можешь сделать мне одолжение и забрать мою посылку?
items.trap: Not 'make sb a favour' (from «сделать одолжение»); the US spelling is 'favor'.

items.definition: to be reasonable, logical or easy to understand
items.example: It doesn't [make sense] to buy a car if you live right next to the metro.
items.exampleRu: Нет смысла покупать машину, если живёшь прямо у метро.
items.pattern: sth makes sense / it makes sense to do sth
items.trap: Not 'it has no sense' (calque of «не имеет смысла»); say 'it makes no sense' or 'there's no point'.

items.definition: to do an official test of your knowledge or skill
items.example: I'm [taking an exam] on Monday, so I can't come out this weekend.
items.exampleRu: В понедельник у меня экзамен, так что на этих выходных я никуда не смогу пойти.
items.trap: «Сдавать экзамен» = take an exam; «сдать» = pass. 'I passed the exam' means you succeeded; never 'give/make an exam'.

items.definition: to eat the first meal of the day
items.example: We usually [have breakfast] together before the kids go to school.
items.exampleRu: Обычно мы завтракаем вместе, перед тем как дети уходят в школу.
items.trap: No article: not 'have a breakfast' (only with an adjective: 'a big breakfast'); 'make breakfast' means cook it.

items.definition: to be involved in an activity or event together with other people
items.example: More than 200 employees [took part in] the survey last month.
items.exampleRu: В прошлом месяце в опросе приняли участие более 200 сотрудников.
collocations: take an active part in sth
items.trap: Not 'take participation' or 'take part at' (calque of «принять участие в»).

items.definition: to buy, sell or work with a person or company commercially
items.example: Our company has been [doing business] with them for over ten years.
items.exampleRu: Наша компания работает с ними уже больше десяти лет.
items.trap: Not 'make business' (calque of «делать бизнес»); it's 'make money' but 'do business'.

items.definition: to be decided or influenced by sth
items.example: Whether we go hiking tomorrow [depends on] the weather.
items.exampleRu: Пойдём ли мы завтра в поход, зависит от погоды.
items.trap: Not 'depend from' or 'depend of' (calque of «зависеть от»).

items.translation: быть женатым на, быть замужем за
items.definition: to be the husband or wife of sb
items.example: She's [married to] a doctor who works at the city hospital.
items.exampleRu: Она замужем за врачом, который работает в городской больнице.
items.trap: Not 'married with' or 'married on' (from «женат на / замужем за»); 'marry sb' has no preposition: 'He married Anna.'

items.definition: to reach a building or particular place
items.example: Please [arrive at] the airport at least two hours before your flight.
items.exampleRu: Пожалуйста, приезжайте в аэропорт минимум за два часа до вылета.
items.pattern: arrive at (a building/point) / arrive in (a city/country)
items.trap: Never 'arrive to' (from «приехать в/к»): arrive at the office, arrive in Paris, and 'arrive home' with no preposition.

items.definition: to want to know or learn more about sth
items.example: I've always been [interested in] history, especially ancient Rome.
items.exampleRu: Меня всегда интересовала история, особенно Древний Рим.
items.pattern: be interested in sth / in doing sth
items.trap: Not 'interested about/by' or 'interesting in'; interested = how you feel, interesting = what causes it.

items.definition: to have the skill or ability to do sth well
items.example: She's really [good at] explaining complicated ideas in simple words.
items.exampleRu: Она очень хорошо умеет объяснять сложные идеи простыми словами.
items.pattern: be good at sth / at doing sth
items.trap: Not 'good in' (from «хорош в»); with people and tools use 'good with': good with kids.

items.definition: to tell sb you are happy about their success or good news
items.example: I called my sister to [congratulate her on] her new job.
items.exampleRu: Я позвонил сестре, чтобы поздравить её с новой работой.
items.pattern: congratulate sb on sth / on doing sth
items.trap: Not 'congratulate with' (calque of «поздравить с»); for holidays just say 'Happy birthday!' or 'Merry Christmas!'.

items.definition: to pay attention to sb or to a sound
items.example: I [listen to] podcasts every morning on my way to work.
items.exampleRu: Каждое утро по дороге на работу я слушаю подкасты.
items.trap: Not 'listen podcasts/music' without 'to' («слушать» takes a direct object); 'to' is dropped only with no object: 'Listen!'

items.definition: to stay somewhere or not act until sb comes or sth happens
items.example: We [waited for] the delivery all afternoon, but it never came.
items.exampleRu: Мы прождали доставку весь день, но её так и не привезли.
items.trap: Not 'wait sb/sth' without 'for' (from «ждать кого-то»); 'await' has no preposition but is formal.

items.definition: to make sth clear or easy for sb to understand
items.example: Could you [explain to me] why the meeting was cancelled?
items.exampleRu: Можешь объяснить мне, почему отменили встречу?
items.pattern: explain sth to sb / explain (to sb) why...
items.trap: Not 'explain me' (from «объясни мне»): say 'explain it to me' or 'explain to me why...'.

items.definition: to be made of or formed from particular parts or people
items.example: The team [consists of] five developers and one designer.
items.exampleRu: Команда состоит из пяти разработчиков и одного дизайнера.
items.trap: Not 'consist from' (calque of «состоять из»); never passive or continuous: not 'is consisted of' or 'is consisting of'.

items.definition: a thin book with articles and photos, published every week or month
items.example: I read an interesting article about remote work in a business [magazine].
items.exampleRu: Я прочитал интересную статью об удалённой работе в деловом журнале.
items.trap: Not «магазин» — a shop is 'shop' or 'store'.

items.definition: correct and exact, without any mistakes
items.example: The weather forecast has been surprisingly [accurate] this week.
items.exampleRu: Прогноз погоды на этой неделе оказался на удивление точным.
items.trap: Not «аккуратный» — that is 'neat', 'tidy' or 'careful'.

items.definition: showing that you understand and care about sb's problems
items.example: My manager was very [sympathetic] when I told her about my father's illness.
items.exampleRu: Моя начальница отнеслась ко мне с большим сочувствием, когда я рассказала ей о болезни отца.
items.trap: Not «симпатичный» — that is 'nice', 'likeable' or 'attractive'.

items.definition: real or exact, often different from what was expected
items.example: The [actual] cost of the project was twice the original estimate.
items.exampleRu: Реальная стоимость проекта оказалась вдвое выше первоначальной оценки.
items.trap: Not «актуальный» — that is 'relevant', 'topical' or 'up to date'; 'actually' means «на самом деле».

items.definition: cloth used for making clothes, curtains, etc.
items.example: This shirt is made of a light [fabric] that's perfect for hot weather.
items.exampleRu: Эта рубашка сшита из лёгкой ткани, которая идеально подходит для жары.
items.trap: Not «фабрика» — that is 'factory'.

items.definition: able to learn, understand and think quickly and well
items.example: She's an [intelligent] student who always asks the right questions.
items.exampleRu: Она умная студентка, которая всегда задаёт правильные вопросы.
items.trap: Not «интеллигентный» — that is closer to 'cultured', 'educated' or 'well-mannered'.

items.definition: a period of ten years
items.example: Prices in this neighbourhood have doubled over the last [decade].
items.exampleRu: За последние десять лет цены в этом районе выросли вдвое.
items.trap: Not «декада» in the sense of ten days — a decade is always ten years.

items.definition: a person who paints, draws or creates other works of art
items.example: My neighbour is an [artist] who sells her paintings online.
items.exampleRu: Моя соседка — художница, она продаёт свои картины в интернете.
items.trap: Usually «художник», not «артист»; a stage performer is a 'performer', 'actor' or 'entertainer'.

items.definition: so weak, bad or useless that it makes you annoyed or sorry
items.example: His excuse for missing the deadline was absolutely [pathetic].
items.exampleRu: Его оправдание за сорванный дедлайн было просто жалким.
items.trap: Not «патетический» (solemn, emotional) — 'pathetic' is negative: weak, useless or pitiful.

items.definition: the possibility that something will happen, especially something good
items.example: The [prospect] of working from home attracted many applicants to the job.
items.exampleRu: Возможность работать из дома привлекла на эту вакансию многих кандидатов.
items.pattern: the prospect of sth / of doing sth
items.trap: Not «проспект» (a wide street) — that is 'avenue'; 'prospects' (plural) = chances of future success.

items.definition: to lie down in your bed in order to sleep
items.example: I try to [go to bed] before midnight on weekdays.
items.exampleRu: В будни я стараюсь ложиться спать до полуночи.
items.trap: No article: not 'go to the bed' (that means walk to the furniture); 'go to sleep' means fall asleep.

items.definition: now, at this time
items.example: I'm afraid she's not available [at the moment]; can I take a message?
items.exampleRu: Боюсь, сейчас она не может подойти. Что-нибудь передать?
items.trap: Not 'in this moment' (calque of «в данный момент»); 'in the moment' means something else (fully focused on the present). Use 'at the moment'.

items.definition: at the place where you work, or busy working
items.example: Sorry I missed your call, I was [at work] all day.
items.exampleRu: Извини, что пропустил звонок, я весь день был на работе.
items.trap: No article and not 'on work' (from «на работе»): at work, go to work, from work.

items.translation: сходить к врачу, обратиться к врачу
items.definition: to visit a doctor to get medical help
items.example: If the pain doesn't go away, you should [go to the doctor].
items.exampleRu: Если боль не пройдёт, тебе стоит сходить к врачу.
items.trap: Don't drop the article: not 'go to doctor' (Russian has no articles); same with 'go to the dentist'.

items.definition: used to say you are disappointed or sorry about something
items.example: You can't come to the party on Saturday? [What a shame]!
items.exampleRu: Ты не сможешь прийти на вечеринку в субботу? Как жаль!
items.pattern: what a + countable noun / what + uncountable noun
items.trap: Don't drop 'a': not 'What shame!'; but no 'a' with uncountable nouns: 'What nice weather!'

items.definition: at the final part of a period, event or place
items.example: We'll discuss the budget [at the end of] the meeting.
items.exampleRu: Бюджет мы обсудим в конце встречи.
items.trap: Not 'in the end of' (from «в конце»); 'in the end' alone means «в итоге»: In the end, we chose the cheaper option.

items.definition: a few days ago; recently
items.example: I ran into an old classmate at the supermarket [the other day].
items.exampleRu: На днях я случайно встретил в супермаркете бывшего одноклассника.
items.trap: Means «на днях» (in the past), not «на следующий день» ('the next day') or «в другой день» ('another day').

items.definition: using a car to travel
items.example: It takes about forty minutes to get to the office [by car].
items.exampleRu: До офиса на машине ехать минут сорок.
items.trap: No article and not 'on car' or 'with car' (from «на машине»); but 'in my car', 'on the bus'.
